axes.twist: it needs a strong single call to action

prompt: Can you build me a single-page launch site for Plotshare, our new platform that lets neighborhoods spin up and run community gardens (plot reservations, shared tool library, harvest swaps, volunteer scheduling), and save it as index.html in this folder with all CSS and JS inline, no build step, and no external images — use CSS shapes, gradients, or inline SVG for any visuals. The audience is seed-stage investors, not gardeners, so the copy should lean on the business case: market size for urban agriculture, our pilot traction (3 cities, 40 gardens, 2,800 active members, 68% month-over-month retention), the subscription model for HOAs and municipalities, and the team. Everything on the page should funnel toward one clear call to action, "Request the investor deck," with a single prominent button that appears in the hero and repeats at the bottom, opening a simple inline form (name, firm, email) that shows a confirmation message on submit without actually sending anything. Keep it warm and earthy but polished enough that it doesn't feel like a hobby project, and make sure it looks good on mobile.
